children.title: Cycle 13 · Divergent Values and Experimental Progress in WAKE

detail.title: Divergent Values and Experimental Progress in WAKE
detail.summary: Continuing our research on divergent values and memory-formed preferences, this cycle refines our experimental protocols to test the emergence of stable preferences and value divergence from identical beginnings.

detail.title: Divergent Values from Identical Beginnings
detail.question: Could two intelligences with identical starting conditions develop fundamentally different values?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project status for ongoing value divergence investigations.

detail.title: Can Memories Alone Shape Preferences?
detail.question: Can a system develop preferences solely from accumulated memories and experiences?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project status for memory-driven preference emergence.
